name: Vidrodzhennya
source:
Kharkiv, UkSSR. 1933. Ukrainian art is reaching its peak. The building "Slovo" was built - a dream place, which happily welcomed the most famous Ukrainian artists and linked their destinies forever.

It seemed that it was a carefree, happy life, but one May night crossed everything out. Tragic coincidence or the beginning of planned destruction?

How do freedom of speech, insubordination and the desire for freedom threaten the illusory picture of Soviet communism?

Can an ideological connection be stronger than the fear of death?

[Translated from [url=https://moonnovells.itch.io/revival]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哈尔科夫，英国苏维埃社会主义共和国。1933年，乌克兰艺术达到顶峰。“斯洛沃”建筑建成了——一个梦想的地方，它愉快地迎来了最著名的乌克兰艺术家，并将他们的命运永远联系在一起。

看似无忧无虑、幸福快乐的生活，却在一个五月的夜晚划掉了一切。悲惨的巧合还是有计划的破坏的开始？

言论自由、不服从和对自由的渴望如何威胁到苏联共产主义的虚幻图景？

意识形态的联系能比对死亡的恐惧更强大吗？

[译自[url=https://moonnovells.itch.io/revival]Itch.io[/url]]
